narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors obligated $2.5B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors received 7 awards this period, with an average award size of $355M. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $2.5B to Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $11.9M to Southwest Valley Constructors in the same period. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction was the largest NAICS market for Southwest Valley Constructors at $2.5B, followed by Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at $11.9M. Historical obligations for Southwest Valley Constructors show $78.4M in FY21 and $2.5B in FY26. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial and cover fiscal year to date. This summary highlights obligations, top buying agencies, and top NAICS markets tied to Southwest Valley Constructors during the stated period.

sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction generated $2.5B of obligations for Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction generated $11.9M of obligations for Southwest Valley Constructors in the same period.

faq.q: How much does Southwest Valley Constructors make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors obligated $2.5B from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors received 7 awards this period with an average award size of $355M. Historical obligations for Southwest Valley Constructors include $78.4M in FY21 and $2.5B in FY26.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Southwest Valley Constructors?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Defense buy from Southwest Valley Constructors. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $2.5B to Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $11.9M to Southwest Valley Constructors in the same period.

faq.q: What does Southwest Valley Constructors sell to the government?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors sells construction services to the government, led by Commercial and Institutional Building Construction and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $2.5B of obligations to Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounted for $11.9M of obligations to Southwest Valley Constructors.
